name: My Husband Is A Mafia Boss
original_name: My Husband Is A Mafia Boss
overview: It follows Aemie, a cheerful and clumsy ordinary girl, who unexpectedly enters a forced marriage with Ezekiel, a cold, ruthless, and wealthy mafia boss. Despite their contrasting personalities and dangerous surroundings, they slowly fall in love while navigating rival family secrets and betrayal.
